column2: By Vasishtha's service seven sons of Girika were born: Brihadratha, Kusha, Vira, Yadu, Pratyagraha, Bala,
Matsyakali; from Brihadratha, the king, was Kushagra; from Kushagra Vrishabha was born; his son Satyahita;
Sudhanva his son; Urja; from Urja Sambhava; from Sambhava Jarasandha, and Sahadeva his son;
from Sahadeva Udapi; from Udapi Shrutakarmaka; Parikshit's heir the righteous Janamejaya;
from Janamejaya Trasadasyu; Jahnu's son Suratha; Shrutasena, Ugrasena and Bhimasena by name;
Janamejaya's two sons Suratha and Mahiman; from Suratha Viduratha; from Viduratha Riksha;
of the second Riksha Bhimasena was the son; Pratipa from Bhimasena; of Pratipa Shantanu;
Devapi and Bahlika and Somadatta were Shantanu's; from Bahlika Somadatta; Bhuri, Bhurishrava, Shala;
on Ganga Bhishma of Shantanu; on Kali Vichitravirya; and Krishna Dvaipayana on Vichitravirya's field;
he begot Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura. Pandu's on Kunti: Yudhishthira, Bhima and Arjuna, three;
Nakula and Sahadeva on Madri of Pandu, by divine (Ashvins); of Arjuna, Saubhadra; from Abhimanyu, Parikshit.
Draupadi was dear to the Pandavas; on her from Yudhishthira Pratavindhya; from Bhimasena Shrutakirti; from Dhananjaya;
from Sahadeva Shrutakarma, Shatanika from Nakula; from Bhimasena on Hidimba another, Ghatotkacha.
These past and future kings are countless; gone by time, for time is Hari; one should worship him, twice-born; having addressed the oblation in the fire, do what gives all.
Barley meal, wheat, parched grain, barley, rice, lentils, with kushtha, chickpeas and mudga are edible; wheat preparations are beneficial,
prepared with ghee and milk, honey, bull's juice (vasaka) and honey. In diarrhea eating old rice is beneficial.
Food that does not cause moisture, with lodhra bark; wind-causing things should be avoided with effort; it should be done in all ways in abdominal tumors.
One should eat vatya with milk, vastuka cooked with ghee. Wheat and rice, bitter things, are beneficial for those with abdominal disease;
wheat, rice, mudga, brahmarksha, khadira, abhaya, pancha-kola, jangala meats, neem, amalaka and patola;
citron juice, jati, dry radish and rock salt; and for those with skin disease khadira water is praised as drink;
lentil and mudga for drinking, old rice for food; vegetables with neem and parpataka, and likewise the broth of jangala animals.
Vidanga, pepper, mustaka, kushtha, lodhra, suvarchika, manahshila and baleya, ground in urine, destroy skin disease.
Cakes, kushtha, kulmasha, barley and the like are beneficial for the urinary-disorder patients; barley preparations, mudga, kulattha, old rice;
bitter, dry vegetables, bitter and green ones; oils of sesame, shigru, vibhitaka and ingudi;
mudga with barley and wheat, grain that has stayed a year, and the broth of jangala animals are praised in the diet of consumptives.
With kulattha, mudga, rasna, dry radish, and jangala meat, or cakes and vishkara prepared with curds and pomegranate,
refined with citron juice, honey, grapes and the three pungents, one should feed barley, wheat and rice food to one with asthma and cough.
Drinks, cake-juices and decoctions prepared with the ten roots, bala, rasna and kulattha ward off breathlessness and hiccup.
With dry radish, kulattha-root and jangala broths; old barley, wheat and rice food with ushira one should take.
One with swelling should eat pathya with jaggery or jaggery and ginger; buttermilk and chitraka both destroy sprue disease.
Old barley, wheat and rice, jangala broth, mudga, amalaka, dates, grapes and jujube;
honey, ghee, milk, sugar, neem and parpataka, vasaka, and buttermilk preparations are always praised for those with wind disease.
Heart-disease patients are to be purged; pippali is beneficial for hiccup. Buttermilk, avala, salts, released with cool water,
released sauvarchala and aja and the like; wine is praised in intoxication. A wounded man should drink lac with honey and milk.
One should conquer consumption by living on meat-juice, by protecting the digestive fire. Red rice, nivara, kalama and the like in food;
barley preparations, meat, vegetables, sauvarchala, shati, pathya likewise for the piles; the thin gruel and buttermilk with water;
practice with mustaka, and a paste with chitraka and turmeric; barley preparations, rice, vastuka with sauvarchala;
cucumber, urvaru and wheat joined with milk, sugarcane and ghee are praised in urinary difficulty; in drinks thin gruel, liquor and the like.
Parched rice, barley meal, honey, dry meat and parushaka; brinjal, avashikhi, and drinks destroy vomiting.
Rice food, water and milk, boiled only warm, destroy thirst; or a pill of mustaka and jaggery held in the mouth.
Barley preparations, cakes, dry radish products, vegetables, patola and the tip of cane destroy thigh-stiffness.
With broths of mudga, adhaka and lentil, with sesame, jangala broths, with rock salt, ghee, grapes, ginger, amalaka and jujube,
one should practice old wheat, barley and rice food with soups. In erysipelas, water with sugar, honey, grapes and pomegranate;
light things such as red shashtika rice, wheat, barley, mudga; and kakamari, tip of cane, vastuka and sauvarchala;
for destroying wind-blood disease water, sugar and honey are praised; in nose diseases ghee prepared with durva is beneficial;
oil prepared in bhringaraja juice or amalaka juice; nasal medicine is desired in all diseases and in those arising from head worms.
Cold water, food and drink, and eating sesame, Brahmin, are said to strengthen the teeth, and are the supreme satisfaction.
Gargle with sesame oil is supreme for strengthening the teeth; vidanga powder with cow-urine destroys worms everywhere;
amalaka fruits and ghee are the best head-application; for destroying head disease, oily and warm food;
oil or goat's urine is the best filling for the ear; to destroy earache, or all sour things, twice-born.
Mountain clay, sandal, lac, jasmine bud, if joined as a wick, it removes the disease of the eye (wound-white);
the three pungents with triphala and little water, and likewise rasanjana, calm all eye diseases;
fried in ghee, ground on stone with lodhra, kanji and rock salt, it is beneficial for removing watering and all eye diseases.
A paste of mountain clay and sandal is praised outside the eye; to ward off eye disease one should always use triphala,
at night with honey and ghee, one wishing long life. Milk and ghee prepared in shatavari juice are aphrodisiac;
kalambika and masha, milk and ghee are aphrodisiac likewise. Triphala is to be known as life-giving, with licorice as before;
with licorice juice and the rest it destroys wrinkles and grey hair. Ghee prepared with vacha, Brahmin, destroys spirit afflictions,
is fit for ancestral rites, gives intelligence and accomplishes all aims. Oil prepared with decoction and paste of bala is beneficial for anointing;
or with rasna and sahachara oil for those with wind disorders. Food that does not cause moisture is praised in wounds;
barley-meal balls and sourness are praised for ripening; when ripe, in bursting, and neem powder in healing.
Likewise purificatory care, and especially offerings, and the protection of a woman in childbirth are always beneficial to beings.
Eating neem leaves is the remedy for one bitten by a snake; palm and neem leaves, hair-benefiting, old oil, ghee of barley;
for one bitten by a scorpion, fumigation or with peacock-feather ghee; ground with arka milk, lopa, seeds of palasha;
or krishna and shiva with fruit for one tormented by a scorpion; arka milk, sesame, oil, sesame paste and jaggery in equal parts;
by drinking, quickly conquers the dog-poison hard to ward; having drunk root of trivrit equal with ghee, of tanduliya,
one quickly conquers the poisons of snakes and insects, even very strong. Sandal, padmaka, kushtha, lata, ambu, ushira, patala,
nirgundi, sariva, selu — a medicine removing spider poison. Head-purging with jaggery and ginger is praised, twice-born;
in oil-drinking and enema, oil and ghee are best. Fire is best for sweating; cold water for staunching;
trivrit is best in purging, madana in vomiting; enema, purgation, emesis, oil, ghee and honey are in order the supreme medicines for wind, bile and phlegm.
May Brahma, Daksha, the Ashvins, Rudra, Indra, Earth, Moon, Sun, Wind and Fire, the sages, herbs, villages and hosts of beings protect you.
May this medicine be for you like a rejuvenative for the sages, like nectar for the gods, like ambrosia for the best serpents.
A country with wind and phlegm trouble, many trees and much water is famed as marshy (anupa); jangala is without these;
a country with some trees and water is remembered as common (sadharana); jangala has much bile; the middle is remembered as common.
Wind is rough, cold, moving; bile is hot, with the three pungents; phlegm they say is stable, sour, oily, sweet;
increase comes by what is like them, the reverse by opposites. Tastes: sweet, sour and salty produce phlegm and destroy wind.
